selection: All rows in each of the four captured SOURCE_ROWS files except source_index values already present in the 100-row SELECTED file. Preserve original source order. No outcome-dependent selection or removal.
scope: Post-discovery diagnostic expansion within the same captured splits. Not independent framework validation, prevalence, or external deployment impact.
adapter: Use the already documented choice_adapter.py without changing it; preserve both raw and reviewed reports.
outcomes: native contract failures and independent source probes
reviewed checker outcomes and false alerts
native source-label scoring fixtures and corrected fixtures
failure_policy: Record all exceptions and preserve every source row. An execution error is not a pass or a model result.
